tools.name: brightspace.file_text
tools.description: Download a Brightspace course file as the signed-in student and return its text: a PDF (read with Mozilla's PDF.js, pages separated by a form feed line) or a text file (HTML, code, CSV, Markdown...). Name the file by orgUnitId and topicId (from /d2l/api/le/1.75/{orgUnitId}/content/toc, a topic whose TypeIdentifier is File) or by its Brightspace url (a Valence file endpoint or a /content/enforced/ link). Other file types (Word, PowerPoint, images) are refused with their type. Read-only.

orgUnitId.description: The course's org unit id; with topicId

topicId.description: The content topic id; with orgUnitId

url.description: Or: the file's https Brightspace URL

tools.name: courses.detail
tools.description: Read official YES course description and prerequisite text, preserving ambiguous prose as unknown instead of guessing. Course ID and offer number come from courses.search or the official planner. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

tools.name: courses.search
tools.description: Search the live YES catalog for course IDs, titles, schools and typical offerings. Vanderbilt's keyword search can return broad matches; select by returned course code. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

tools.name: courses.sections
tools.description: Read live YES section alternatives with campus-local meeting times, professor, room, availability and lecture/lab component. Missing or TBA times are explicit. No cart/enrollment changes. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

tools.name: degree.audit
tools.description: Read Vanderbilt's official degree-audit requirement groups, status, counters and existing planner courses. No audit refresh, enrollment or planner mutation; report timestamps are preserved. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

tools.name: degree.graph
tools.description: Build a directed graph from the authenticated student's official YES audit, including all current requirement groups/lines, satisfying courses and optional planner courses. Official course alternatives load separately via degree.options; this does not invent degree rules. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

tools.name: degree.options
tools.description: Read all official course satisfiers for one current degree-audit requirement line. Report and entry IDs come from degree.audit/degree.graph; the student identity is resolved internally from the authenticated audit. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

tools.name: grades.whatif
tools.description: GPA projection: apply hypothetical grades (replacing posted ones, filling unposted ones) and report per-term and cumulative GPAs. Uses the student's live YES record unless a transcript is passed. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

transcript.description: Omit to use the live YES record

tools.name: planner.graph
tools.description: Deterministically rank paths for supplied official requirement alternatives and/or course goals. Shared prerequisites count once; completed and planned work is factored in. Unknown prose, missing metadata, cycles and truncation remain explicit. A model-optimal result is exhaustive only for supplied inputs; degree.audit remains the official authority.

tools.name: professors.search
tools.description: Look up public Vanderbilt Rate My Professors candidates and ratings. Preserves namesake ambiguity; no Vanderbilt credentials leave the toolkit.

tools.name: record.fetch
tools.description: The student's YES academic record as a parsed transcript (posted terms plus in-progress unposted courses), with a check that recomputes each term's GPA and the cumulative GPA from the posted marks and compares them with Vanderbilt's own posted figures. Trust a what-if only when verification.ok is true. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

tools.name: request
tools.description: Send one HTTP request to any Vanderbilt (*.vanderbilt.edu) or Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Office, SharePoint, login) web endpoint as the signed-in student, and get the service's own response back. The stored sessions ride every sign-in hop (OneVU/Okta, Entra, SAML and OIDC form posts); a refused session is re-minted with the toolkit passkey and the request retried once, so there is no sign-in step for the caller. Brightspace (/d2l/ paths) is signed in to first when needed and sent Brightspace's own CSRF token (X-Csrf-Token), as its pages do. A file (PDF, image, Office document) comes back as a one-line description, not decoded bytes; brightspace.file_text reads a course file's text. Use it for the services' own APIs, e.g. Brightspace's D2L Valence API (https://brightspace.vanderbilt.edu/d2l/api/lp/1.46/users/whoami, /d2l/api/lp/1.46/enrollments/myenrollments/, /d2l/api/le/1.75/{orgUnitId}/content/toc, /d2l/api/le/1.75/{orgUnitId}/dropbox/folders/, /d2l/api/le/1.75/{orgUnitId}/grades/values/myGradeValues/, /d2l/api/le/1.75/{orgUnitId}/news/), YES pages, or SharePoint. Outlook's mail APIs (Outlook REST, Microsoft Graph) take an OAuth bearer token, not the signed-in session: a 401 from a Microsoft host is retried once on a freshly minted session, and when it is still 401 it comes back with a trace line saying the endpoint wants a token; read mail in the signed-in browser. Cookie values never appear in the result. YES is read-only: enrollment and cart or planner changes there are refused. A non-GET request elsewhere acts on the student's account: send one only for something the student asked for. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

url.description: Absolute https URL on a Vanderbilt or Microsoft 365 host

headers.description: Extra request headers (a Cookie header is ignored)

body.description: Request body, sent as given; set content-type in headers

maxChars.description: Bound on the returned response text

tools.name: scheduler.solve
tools.description: Enumerate conflict-free section combinations; include labs, multiple meetings, course exclusions and preferred break times. Deterministic preference ranking and explicit truncation/TBA uncertainty. Returns choices, never enrollment actions.

tools.name: sessions.ensure
tools.description: Return the cached session for the IdP when it still works, or mint a fresh one and cache it: the OneVU passkey ceremony for vanderbilt, the Entra carry for microsoft. force=true re-mints even a working session; a failed mint keeps the current one. Other operations call this themselves, so it is only needed to warm or repair a session. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

tools.name: sessions.forget
tools.description: Drop a cached session: removes its row (metadata and values) from the session vault.

tools.name: sessions.ingest
tools.description: Ingest a harvested browser cookie export into the session store: keeps only cookies in the IdP's domain scope and reports metadata only.

sourcePath.description: Path to the harvested cookie JSON: a CDP cookie array, {cookies:[...]}, or {cookieHeader}

tools.name: sessions.list
tools.description: Cached Vanderbilt SSO and Microsoft sessions: metadata only (idp, acquired, expiry, health). Session values never leave the vault.

tools.name: sessions.open
tools.description: Injection payload for a stored session, for a local browser on the student's own machine: raw Cookie header, CDP Network.setCookie params, or Playwright storageState. Never logged or echoed anywhere else. Remote deployments do not offer it. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

tools.name: setup.enroll
tools.description: Issue a toolkit passkey through OneVU's security-method enrollment. Requires authenticated managed-browser sign-in and explicit account-holder confirmation. For recovery only, replaceExisting=true stages and vault-verifies the newly issued credential, preserves the prior key in VANDERBILT_PASSKEY_PREVIOUS, then promotes the new key; use only after the account holder reports the current toolkit key was rejected and confirms the browser is signed into their own configured account. Never accepts secrets in arguments or revokes OneVU passkeys. Returns metadata only. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

replaceExisting.description: Recovery only: replace the toolkit's current vaulted key after OneVU issues and the host vault verifies a new one. Requires explicit account-holder confirmation.

tools.name: setup.identity
tools.description: Configure the account's non-secret Vanderbilt email and/or VUnetID in the native host vault. A VUnetID alone supplies its Vanderbilt sign-in address. Never accepts passwords or passkeys. Refuses to change an identity while an existing passkey is bound to another account.

tools.name: setup.prepare
tools.description: Prepare a dedicated OneVU tab for the account holder to sign in. Normal setup may load the configured toolkit passkey; recovery=true deliberately does not load or retry the rejected key and requires the holder to use their usual sign-in method. Does not issue or change credentials. The visible page must match the configured student's email before enrollment. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

keepTab.description: Keep the dedicated OneVU tab open so the account holder can sign in.

recovery.description: Recovery only: do not load/use the rejected toolkit passkey; allow the account holder to sign in through OneVU's normal flow.

tools.name: setup.run
tools.description: Deterministic one-call Vanderbilt setup or explicit passkey recovery. Uses this host's configured identity and optional vaulted VANDERBILT_PASSWORD, first reusing an authenticated browser session. On first-time setup it enrolls and vault-verifies a new OneVU passkey, then establishes Vanderbilt and Microsoft sessions. status=partial means Vanderbilt is ready but Microsoft is not; do not claim full setup. Existing valid keys are reused, never rotated. recovery=true skips a rejected key and preserves it as a vault backup. With allowInteractiveVerification=false, setup does not submit a password or click a verification factor; OneVU may still require step-up for enrollment. Returns no credentials. Typed errors tell the caller what prerequisite or one-time verification is missing. Pass timeoutSeconds: 300 when a sign-in may be needed (integer 1-570; whole-call deadline).

confirm.description: Account-holder authorization to enroll a toolkit passkey if necessary.

recovery.description: Only when the existing toolkit key was rejected by OneVU; preserve it and enroll a replacement.

allowInteractiveVerification.description: False: use an existing signed-in browser session only; never submit a password or click a verification factor. OneVU may independently require step-up.

passkeyAssertion.description: The active vaulted key completed an isolated OneVU WebAuthn assertion; its observed counter was saved.

microsoftError.description: Safe failure code when Microsoft session is not ready; no account data or token values.

tools.name: setup.status
tools.description: Check Vanderbilt account setup without returning credentials: configured identity, structural passkey validity, managed-browser availability and the next step. Structural validity does not prove OneVU accepts the key.

tools.name: web
tools.description: Open this tool's web app: serves the operations page and the MCP endpoint on a free local port, opens a browser there, and returns the URL.
